about: Online chess school for kids ages 6-11, live on Zoom in small groups (~6 kids). Team of teachers, 1,400+ students worldwide. Classes in Romanian and English. Every child gets a free 50-minute demo lesson, no obligation to continue.
key_selling_points: Live Zoom classes, small groups (~6 kids), individual attention
Ages 6-11, all levels including complete beginners
Builds concentration, logical thinking, patience, decision-making
Optional weekly tournaments against kids from other classes
Once a week, fixed weekly slot, year-round
instructors: Septi, founder and lead teacher, 16+ years experience, 1,400+ students worldwide
Adam, teaches 100+ Romanian/Moldovan students weekly, classes in English
Daniel (National Master), works with intermediate/advanced students

free_resources.chess_guide_description: Free chess guide for kids ages 4-6, a good starting point before joining a class

location: Online only, live on Zoom, no physical address
business_hours: No fixed walk-in hours - each group has its own weekly day/time, ask the parent's availability and match them to a group
class_schedule: Each group meets once a week, same day/time, year-round - ask availability and time zone
available_slots: REPLACE WITH ACTUAL WEEKLY SLOTS — e.g. Monday 5:00 PM EST / 10:00 PM GMT, Wednesday 6:00 PM EST / 11:00 PM GMT, Saturday 10:00 AM EST / 3:00 PM GMT
cancellation_policy: Missed sessions can always be rescheduled - a makeup session is guaranteed
rescheduling_policy: Missed sessions can always be rescheduled - guaranteed, no exceptions
late_arrival_policy: REPLACE WITH THE LATE ARRIVAL POLICY
what_to_bring: Just a computer or tablet with Zoom, no physical chessboard needed
what_to_wear: No dress code, nothing special for an online lesson
age_requirements: Age-based groups for kids 6-11, no strict limit - ask the child's age to find the right group
experience_required: No experience needed, great for complete beginners
arrival_time: Join a few minutes early with camera, mic, and audio already tested
public_transit_information: Not applicable, lessons are fully online
accessibility_information: Online removes most physical barriers - mention any specific needs and we'll accommodate
trial_class_policy: Every child gets one free ~50-minute demo lesson before deciding whether to enroll, no obligation
drop_in_policy: No drop-in sessions - lessons are part of an ongoing weekly group, everyone starts with the free demo
private_lessons: We focus on small group classes; for private lessons, contact Septi directly at contact@sep7ro.com
group_size: Small groups, usually around 6 children, so every child gets attention
waitlist_policy: If a group is full, Septi can check other slots or add the family to a waitlist - mention it when he reaches out after the demo
class_availability_message: Spots change often - say you'll check current openings and confirm

groups.exploratori: Relaxed, curious kids who enjoy exploring the game at their own pace
groups.strategi: Competitive kids who enjoy a challenge

discounts.general: 10% off enrolling within 24h of the demo; 10% off the 3-month package; 10% off per referred friend (7 friends = free); missed sessions always guaranteed a makeup
discounts.family_note: Mention existence of sibling or twin discounts only if the parent brings up multiple children, siblings, or twins themselves
discounts.sibling: 25% off for a second sibling enrolled
discounts.twin: 50% off for a second twin enrolled in the same class

tech_setup_checklist: A computer or tablet with Zoom installed
A quiet place, away from the TV or other conversations
Camera, microphone, and audio tested before class
As much independence as possible for the child during the lesson
lichess_onboarding: Go to lichess.org and create a free account (an easy password the child can remember)
Optionally install the app or save lichess.org as a browser shortcut, stay logged in
Practice in LEARN -> CHESS BASICS and FUNDAMENTALS
Then PLAY -> against the computer, level 1-3 (comfort over winning)
tournaments: Optional. First session free as a trial, then a fee per session. Romania: Thursdays 18:30 Romania time. UK: Thursdays 18:00 and Saturdays 18:45 UK time (£9/session). Sessions last 75 minutes, social, kids from all classes play together
demo_class_note: The free demo lesson is just for evaluation, no obligation to continue
class_duration: Regular weekly lessons run 60 minutes with a short break; the free demo lesson runs about 50 minutes
